heading, We are Semble, and this is our story., level 1

Healthcare professionals are among the most dedicated people you’ll ever meet. Yet far too often, they’re held back by fragmented systems and endless admin, leaving less time for what matters most: their patients and even their own wellbeing.
We set out to change that.
end of link, Book a demo
Enable healthcare professionals to amplify their impact.
To shape the future of healthcare by making it more connected.
heading, Two founders, one mission, level 2
Semble began with two friends who shared a simple conviction: healthcare professionals deserved better tools and patients deserved better experiences.
After seeing first-hand how fragmented systems slow down the people providing crucial care to patients, Christoph Lippuner and Mikael Landau knew something had to change.
They were seasoned tech entrepreneurs, new to healthcare but united by a clear idea: a connected, intuitive platform could ease the daily pressures on clinical teams and improve patient care.
They immersed themselves in the realities of healthcare, working side-by-side with doctors and support staff, listening, observing and learning where their existing software fell short.

Those insights were the foundations of Semble. Today, Semble supports over 16,000 healthcare professionals across more than 80 specialities, helping improve the care experience for over 9 million patients.

We’ve distilled what drives us into a set of cultural principles that guide everything we do:
heading, We do work that matters, level 1
We focus on the problems that truly impact clinicians and patients. Every idea, feature and decision is guided by a single question: Will this make someone’s day better?
heading, We're in it together, level 1

Semble isn’t built in isolation. We learn from healthcare professionals every day, share knowledge openly within our team, and collaborate across the wider healthcare ecosystem to build something better, together.

Empathy isn’t just a word, it’s how we operate. We care about clinicians, about patients, about the work we create and about the people who use it. That empathy shapes every line of code, every support conversation, every roadmap decision.
heading, Shape the future of healthcare with us, level 2
Inspirational people are everywhere and we’ve been lucky to bring many of them together at Semble. Today, our team represents over 25 nationalities across France, the UK and Europe.
What unites us isn’t geography, but purpose: a deep interest in healthcare and a shared desire to build something meaningful.
We’re always growing, and we’d love to meet you.
end of link, See our open roles
Throughout this journey we’ve gained the support of some fantastic investors – including visionary doctors and consultants – who
believed in our our ambitions and helped bring them to the healthcare industry.
